'''Ferenc András Kalmár''' (born 1955)<ref name="Biography">{{cite web|url=http://www.parlament.hu/kepv/eletrajz/hu/k102.pdf |title=''Biography'' |publisher=[[National Assembly of Hungary|Országgyűlés]]}}</ref> is a Hungarian physicist and politician, [[National Assembly of Hungary|member of the National Assembly]] (MP) from [[Fidesz]]–[[Christian Democratic People's Party (Hungary)|KDNP]] [[Csongrád County]] Regional List between 2010 and 2014.<ref name="Register">{{cite web|url=http://www.parlament.hu/internet/plsql/ogy_kpv.kepv_adat?p_azon=k102&p_ckl=39|title=''Register'' |publisher=[[National Assembly of Hungary|Országgyűlés]]}}</ref>

Kalmár was born in [[Brașov]], [[Communist Romania|Romania]] into an [[Hungarians in Romania|ethnic Hungarian]] family. He attended [[University of Bucharest]], where he graduated in 1980.<ref name="Biography"/> On 1 April 2015, he was appointed Ministerial Commissioner for Hungary's Neighbourhood Policy by Foreign Minister [[Péter Szijjártó]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.delmagyar.hu/szeged_hirek/miniszteri_biztos_lett_kalmar_ferenc_andras/2426080/ |title=Miniszteri biztos lett Kalmár Ferenc András |date=2015-04-17 |accessdate=2015-11-11 | publisher=Delmagyar.hu | language=Hungarian}}</ref>

==Personal life==
He is married and has two children.<ref>[http://nol.hu/belfold/20100427-fidesz_-_kdnp-639601 Fidesz-KDNP] - [[Népszabadság]]</ref>
